name: Syncophant
platformNote: Native macOS 26 app (SwiftUI and AppKit). The documenter schema has no macOS value; this file does not claim web or iOS.

accent.role: Only brand hue. Tint, selection, folders, upload activity, kept on this Mac.

navy.role: Connect sheet titles and menu bar mark. Never a surface fill.

verified.role: Only for On your box · verified, earned by an engine receipt.

caution.role: Conflict copies, unverified uploads, demo banner.

failure.role: Failed uploads, host key changed, unreachable storage.

sky.role: Environment light behind glass, top-left. Never text or status.

typography.monospaced: Hosts, fingerprints, paths and Size column digits

components: File row (NSOutlineView 34 pt rows: Name, Size, Modified, Status; rounded accent selection pill, hover wash)
Status pill (symbol plus text, tinted wash, never colour alone)
Storage row and floating storage summary card (real values only)
Transfer row (determinate from engine bytes; speed and ETA only when sampled)
Issue row (plain cause, one fix button)
Floating glass notice capsule and in-canvas strips (demo, refresh, search scope)
Connect option row (12 pt fill, 1.5 pt accent ring when selected)
Host key trust card (explicit Trust this key)

icon.description: Original white elephant head and trunk on a blue tile (#4DA3FF to #0A5FDB); the ears are two open rings that read as a two-sided sync loop and as storage discs.

materials.glass: SwiftUI glassEffect(.regular) in continuous rounded shapes, GlassEffectContainer for groups, .glass and .glassProminent button styles; system glass for sidebar, toolbar and search.
materials.canvas: Opaque textBackgroundColor reading surface, 22 pt radius, 0.5 pt separator, shadow 0.10 black 14 pt blur 5 pt y.
materials.environment: AmbientBackdrop: three radial washes (sky, lavender, ember) over windowBackgroundColor.
materials.fallback: Reduce Transparency: no colour field, glass replaced by controlBackgroundColor fill with 1 pt separator.

supersedes: Earlier rule 'no gradients, no decorative glass' replaced by explicit user request for real Liquid Glass; glass limited to floating surfaces.
